Yep...  I've already got the plugins in the right order according to the Plugin List on
This Site
.
Second...  As I mentioned in my original post,
Extra Enemy Drops
does not allow for variable amounts. You can place multiple of the same item over and over again to get more of that item, but if you want to have that option be determined by a variable then you can't.
Let me see if I can explain this better:
Extra Enemy Drops:
Code:
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
  VARIABLE 1 === 1: 50%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
This code can be repeated as many times as you want to get this item over and over again at a 50% rate as long as the variable is at 1.
But there is no option to allow you to determine the actual amount of the item given by variable.
Something like HIME's script which is like this:
Code:
<enemy drop>
  item_code: "i1",
  amount: v.value(1),
  chance: "50"
</enemy drop>
or
Code:
<enemy drop>
  item_code: "i1",
  amount: 5
</enemy drop>
which will now give my player 5 of item 1 without having to make multiple copies of the same code. Plus, if I want to make the item amount based on a stat [say the combined Luck stat of the entire party]... Like if the combined party LUck is over 100 then give 1 item, and add a plus one item for every 100 Luck the party has. So they could get 5 items if they have a combined Luck stat of 500.
Using HIME's plugin that would be a simple Notetag...  Using YEP_ExtraEnemyDrops I would have to place a Notetag for each item that could be given at each variable change.
Something like this:
Code:
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 4: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 4: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 5: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 5: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 5: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 5: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
<Conditional Item 1 Drop>
VARIABLE 1 === 5: 100%
</Conditional Item 1 Drop>
And I would have to do that every single possibility I can think up.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
Several possibilities.
First is that the error is later in the notetag and everything I write below has nothing to do with it.
Please test that by making a test with only the first notetag, deleting everything after that.
If that suddenly works, then we need a copy of the entire notetag because you made a typo in a later part.
If the error is in the first notetag, the part that most likely causes the syntax error is the line with v.value(80)
Please read the instructions with more care:
<enemy drop>
item_code: "ID",
amount: number,
chance: "FORMULA"
</enemy drop>
v.value(80) is part of a formula and not a direct number, as you can see in tsukihime's examples.
Now there are two possibilities, and unfortunately I couldn't determine which from the plugin code alone.
First option, you have a chance of getting it to work if you enter it as a formula as well, e.g.
amount: "v.value(80)",
If that doesn't work either, then either amount has to be a number or the error is further below in the later parts of the notetag.
